correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all hypotheses (odd q, r>=2, split quadratic norm-one shell, nontrivial additive character). Orthogonality and completion of squares give exact nonzero Gauss normalization; the even-dimensional sphere Fourier transform cannot vanish because q-1 prime-order roots of unity cannot have equal residue multiplicities. The odd-dimensional Salié sum is evaluated by Fourier duality in its quadratic parameter; the c=0 and w=0 boundaries are handled separately. Translating the two-shell incidence equations yields Witt and orthogonal-complement sections. The point counts in odd sections and the discriminant sum -1 yield the closed rank formula. The Weyl basis diagonalizes the lifting, giving exactly the stated kernel. Exact independent residue-count checker tests 929128 pairs in prime and extension fields, but is not used as an infinite proof.
